In this video, we dive deep into Benedict Evans' latest report to separate the hype from the reality. We analyze the massive capital expenditure by tech giants like Microsoft, Google, and Meta, and look at whether the "AI Bubble" is about to burst or if we are witnessing the next great platform shift.
In this breakdown, we cover:
The History of Hype: Comparing AI to the Dot-com bubble and Smartphone era.
The Big Tech War: Strategies from OpenAI, Google, and Microsoft.
The Nvidia Question: Is the chip shortage and growth sustainable?
